objective: Bind the exact single-node node-root/Type-1 market claim to an installable release and passing operational profile; HYPERVISOROS_APPLIANCE_PROFILE_CLAIM_GATE_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: IOI claims a node-root or Type-1 product from schemas, plans, or attestation objects without the bound appliance journey.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

required_work: Publish only the exact passing single-node claim and its nonclaims.
positive_proof: Claim binds one content-bound passing release.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Missing installer, stale evidence, unsupported hardware, or broader wording withdraws claim.

external_gates.condition: The supported release passes node-root conformance and claim review.

remaining_nonclaims: No cluster or universal Type-1 replacement claim.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Withdraw on any bound release or conformance regression.
